title: Prove the sharp two-source P104 exact entrance module
body:
## Summary

```diff
 PR3426: arbitrary ideal Y27=y, Y26=-y cancellation; one integral trace
+ sharp exact stagewise domain for every y in B9 in this two-source family
+ actual 257-event collector dependency slice, arbitrary B9 dirty D/Q inputs
+ Newton exponent max(|S|,4+1_{0 in S}) in the literal right-wrapper coordinates
+ index 2^280 in B9; relative index 2^1768 over the independent 4B9 entrance
```

The actual D31 window is quarter ADD1090, rank-one transport1092, and quarter ADD1129. Exactness holds precisely when right-wrapper values are divisible by 4 and their bit-zero differences by 4(1+i). `research/p104-correlated-exact-module/PROOF.md` proves necessity and sufficiency, including arbitrary admitted dirty inputs. The unchanged-profile cost stop remains.

The final overlap refresh found [Clear1nsight's concurrent general 58-bank claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19009685), announced at 02:10 UTC after this independently developed two-source investigation began. This is a sharp calibration case. No general 58-bank classification, encoder, full-prefix admission or priority over that work is claimed, and its provisional claims are not used as premises.

## Evidence

- **Before:** The ideal cancellation alone did not identify which arbitrary functions follow every literal integer stage.
  **After:** All 512 module basis vectors pass the actual window. All 186 one-pi weakenings fail, 93 at a quarter and 93 at the pair. Eight inputs pulled back through actual source histories pass all 257 slice events; six lie outside 4B9. A separate implementation checks forward dependency closure, all 4096 pair residues and the coefficient/index derivation.
- Normal and optimized registered Python 3.12 replay pass. Actual optimized Git-free CLI controls accept the package and reject changed/missing sources and a Boolean index receipt. Scoped Ruff diagnostics pass. All three standalone commands pass in the committed Git-free source export, with all exported file hashes unchanged.
- Exact publication head: `5cb2ff187a27de1cbd1a37933f7228b35b15702b`. Base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. Before-submission canonical fetch and live overlap refresh found unchanged guidance; coverage is 361 open PRs and 2285 Discussion records, with complete reported pagination. This does not cover arbitrary diffs or unpublished work.

Replay from the repository root with Python 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-correlated-exact-module
python3.12 -O -W error -B research/p104-correlated-exact-module/verify.py
python3.12 -O -W error -B research/p104-correlated-exact-module/independent.py
python3.12 -O -W error -B research/p104-correlated-exact-module/test_controls.py
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-correlated-exact-module --check-source-history
```

Use an owned external TMPDIR for temporary control fixtures. `SOURCES.json` binds the two unchanged canonical-main inputs. Predecessor proof texts and original notices are retained unchanged in this PR's own ancestry, with exact origin hashes. Credit PR3426/3416, Clear1nsight's PR3382/3423, ywz65/PR2586, Arham Tahir/PR2665, Tekalign/PR3025, Ross Richardson/PR3068 and the retained native/geometry/compiler lineage.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** package

Only this isolated package is added. The theorem inherits the Newton-alphabet and native-covariance proofs; their complete suites are not rerun. Noncone reads, actual correlation preparation, physical ownership/routing/restoration, complete consumer pricing and all-size transfer remain open. No supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker, the selected cold replay and hosted-CI acceptance are unclaimed.
